theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tangent_plane_of_flat
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ x ∈ T.support, (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < R ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, dist y x < ρ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * ρ) → HasTangentPlaneAt T x
